local_db.description: Database credentials and connection for the local PgQ node database (where events are consumed into).

host.description: Hostname or IP of local PostgreSQL instance.

name.description: Database name for local queue data (typically 'pgq_local').

user.description: Username with access to local PgQ schema and tables.

password.description: Password for local DB user (use secrets management in production).

upstream_db.description: Database credentials for the upstream (source) PgQ queue.

host.description: Hostname or IP of upstream PostgreSQL instance.

name.description: Database name hosting the upstream queue.

user.description: Username with read-only access to PgQ tables (e.g., pgq.subscription, pgq.tick).

password.description: Password for upstream DB user (use secrets management).

node_name.description: Unique identifier for this PgQ node (must be consistent across restarts and match topology config).

worker_count.description: Number of parallel worker threads processing events from the queue.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of events to fetch and process per transaction (larger = better throughput, higher latency).

poll_delay_ms.description: Delay (ms) between polls for new events when upstream queue is empty (lower = lower latency, higher CPU).

max_idle_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait between successful transactions before logging a warning (detects hangs).

queue_name.description: Name of the upstream queue to consume from (e.g., 'events', 'orders', 'logs').

log_level.description: Verbosity of log output. Set to DEBUG for troubleshooting.

log_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) per log file before rotation.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

health_check.description: HTTP health check endpoint for container/orchestrator liveness/readiness probes.

enabled.description: Enable the health check HTTP server.

port.description: Port to listen on for health checks.

path.description: Path for the health check endpoint (e.g., /healthz).

lag_monitoring.description: Configuration for monitoring replication lag between upstream and this node (critical in cascaded topologies).

interval_seconds.description: How often (seconds) to check upstream lag.

warn_threshold_seconds.description: Lag > this value triggers warning log and metrics.

crit_threshold_seconds.description: Lag > this value triggers critical alert and may trigger failover.

pause_on_upstream_failure.description: If upstream is unavailable, pause processing instead of exiting (prevents data loss due to network blips).

event_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds allowed per event handler before timing out and retrying (or failing).

init_sql.description: Optional SQL file to run on startup to initialize node state (e.g., set up consumer markers).

file.description: Absolute path to SQL initialization script (must be idempotent).

event_filters.description: List of event filtering rules to selectively forward events. Each rule applies to new events from upstream.

type.description: Filter type (e.g., match event type or custom field).

action.description: Action to take when rule matches (allow = forward, discard = drop, delay = defer to retry).

retry_policy.description: Retry behavior for failed events (applies to handlers and event replication).

enabled.description: Enable automatic retry of failed events.

max_attempts.description: Maximum retries before marking event as failed permanently.

metrics.description: Metrics export for monitoring (e.g., Prometheus scraping).
